'''Sassi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] waitress at [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] stopped on Stobar on his way to find [[Darth Maul/Legends|his brother]]. The waitress [[Droid/Legends|droid]], a [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service unit]] named [[Marwigo/Legends|Marwigo]], was unable to take the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak's]] order and passed it off to her Human colleague, Sassi. Sassi attempted the same, but as she displayed interest in and reached for Savage's [[Talisman of Finding/Legends|talisman]], he reacted angrily and choked her. The authorities were notified, but Opress had already escaped. Although she was unconscious and on the floor for several minutes, she was able to get back to her feet, with the assistance of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], upon waking up.

==Behind the scenes==
The scene where Marwigo passes off the order to Sassi and her reaching for his talisman was cut from the final version of the episode.
